name: Humiliation And Self Affliction
overview: Scripture instructs the people of Israel to afflict their souls on the tenth day of the seventh month as a solemn act of humility and repentance, explicitly commanded as a lasting statute (Leviticus 16:29, 31). This self-affliction, accompanied by rest and abstaining from work, is tied to the Day of Atonement, during which the priest makes atonement to cleanse the people from their sins before the LORD (Leviticus 16:30; 23:27-28). These passages emphasize that self-affliction is not merely physical but a spiritual discipline integral to approaching God in holiness and seeking His forgiveness.
